data: All 13 datasets + BrainInWater mri extra from datasets.fetch() only, every file checksum-checked: 40.8 GB on disk in C:\pytomography_data (the page estimated about 70 GB). Took 2 h 23 min at about 5-8 MB/s; no failures.
install_findings: Shipped Acer driver 577.13 supports CUDA 12.9 only, so the documented cu130 stack fails: torch 2.14.1+cu130 can't see the GPU and conda refuses libparallelproj cuda130. For RTX 50 on a pre-580 driver there is no torch 2.14.1 that works: Windows cp312 wheels exist only as cu126 (no Blackwell kernels) and cu130 (cu128 stops at 2.11.0, cu129 at 2.9.0). A CUDA 12 path exists for older GPUs: torch cu126, libparallelproj 2.0.7 cuda129 (accepts cuda-version >=12,<13), cupy-cuda12x 14.2. Install page could say: cu130 needs driver 580+; check nvidia-smi; CUDA 12's libparallelproj build is named cuda129; the cu128 example now gives torch 2.11. Checked against package indexes 9 Nov, not run.
